pos.personaBrief: Bayern under Heynckes had little possession in Europe (Spielverlagerung 4-4-2-0, BTL direct counters) but seized the ball in the Bundesliga; he asked for balance and said keeping the goal clean comes first.

pro.personaBrief: Quick counters and long balls behind in Europe (BTL, Dortmund final), yet calm goalkeeper-based build-up through Neuer and a dropping six against Barca's press.

est.personaBrief: A well-organised 4-2-3-1 morphing into a 4-4-2 block with defined lines, compact distances and wide wingers; structure and positional discipline over improvised relations.

lar.personaBrief: Wingers stretched the field to the maximum (TFT, GFNG final, Bleacher Report, Alaba/Ribery and Lahm/Robben pincers), with overloads on the wings key against Barca.

blo.personaBrief: Mid-to-high compact block with two pressing zones at 25m, high line and offside line, counter-press restored in 2017/18; balanced containment rather than extreme Klopp-style gegenpressing.

mar.personaBrief: Position-orientated zonal marking in the block with situational man orientation when pressing (Spielverlagerung); no dedicated man-marker evidence, though BTL claims centre-backs man-marked.

pla.personaBrief: Imposed a clear Bayern model but adapted game by game (tweaks against Dortmund, Tolisso vs Real, pragmatic selection); he rejects dropping the idea even against stronger sides.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic winner: defence is the foundation, keep the goal clean, economical football; but Bayern still played to win away against strong sides and he valued attacking balance.

sis.personaBrief: Roles were defined and everyone worked for the team (selfless players, ego management, economical pressing), though built on high-quality stars like Ribery, Robben and Neuer.

jog.personaBrief: Wanted intensity and a balanced, strong pivot (Martinez, Schweinsteiger, Mandzukic) while also technically gifted wingers and a ball-playing keeper.

bas.personaBrief: Settled Stammelf of experienced stars and key signings (Martinez, Dante, Mandzukic), though he promoted Alaba and Kroos in 2011 and used Kimmich and Coman.

lid.personaBrief: Former disciplinarian who thawed into a calm, trust-building man-manager, hugging team spirit, direct talks with Robben and Ribery, yet insisted I'm the boss and basic rules for all.
